name: SIQ - Collection Carousel
description: Horizontal scroll-driven collection carousel with a sticky text header on the left. Large rounded collection cards slide through as the user scrolls, while a heading, description, and CTA button remain pinned. Each collection block supports a custom image, overlay, highlighted text chip, title override, and individual button. Supports sticky or scroll content mode, progress bar, card radius, and landscape/square aspect ratio. Perfect for showcasing multiple collections in an editorial, magazine-style layout.
author: SectionIQ
